text: Tameeni, Saudi Arabia's largest online insurance aggregator, is operated by Rasan Information Technology Company, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul 8313) since June 2024; Rasan's own site says Tameeni marked the beginning of Rasan's disruption of Saudi Arabia's insurance market in 2017. Per Rasan's IPO documents as reported by MENAbytes, Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46 was Rasan's single largest shareholder at listing, its 18.65% stake diluting to 13.06% after the IPO.
short: Tameeni is operated by Rasan Information Technology Company (Tadawul 8313); Saudi VC Impact46 was Rasan's single largest shareholder at listing (13.06% post-IPO).
